services.name: Kona Snorkeling Tours
services.desc: Our environmental initiatives focus on minimizing our impact & bettering the planet. We offer incredible snorkeling and other fun water activities perfect for the whole family out of magnificent Keauhou Bay on our tours. The award-winning afternoon snorkeling trip to Kealakekua Bay is a must-do on the Big Island! A shorter version of our popular morning snorkel tour, the afternoon tour is a 3-½ hour adventure to the incredible Kealakekua Bay! The British erected the Captain Cook Monument on the shore of Kealakekua Bay to commemorate this site as the place that Captain James Cook initially made landfall in Hawai’i, which also was the place that he perished.
